taskContracts.objective: Define the P66 implementation contract only; no self-healing behavior.

inputs.narrowScope: Define the P66 implementation contract only; no self-healing behavior.
safetyRules: Do not enable source mutation, project mutation, provider upload, provider dispatch, tool execution, code execution, worker execution, automatic retry, DB writes, deploy, release, external network calls, or provider spend.
Self-healing begins as failure classification, recovery preview, and safety gating only.
Recovery proposals must remain explicit, bounded, evidence-linked, approval-aware, and display-disabled until a later phase explicitly allows execution.
Primary UX must not expose raw JSON, raw logs, raw policy dumps, raw private project IDs, fake runnable repair actions, or DemoApp outside demo mode.

reuseCheck.rule: Reuse existing retry, recovery, incident, redaction, report, status, and Command Center patterns; do not duplicate helpers.

uxUpdate.scope: No Command Center page behavior changes in this subphase unless explicitly listed.
uxUpdate.required: UX must show failure class, current state, proposed recovery, blockers, disabled action reason, owner capability, evidence/activity location, cost impact, and next action.

dataShapes: failureId, failureClass, severity, sourceSurface, ownerCapability, currentState, proposedRecovery, blockers, retryLimit, approvalRequired, mutationAllowed, executionAllowed, disabledReason, costImpact, evidenceRefs, activityRefs, nextAction

inputs.commandCenterUxRequirements: Command Center must show failure class, current state, proposed recovery, blockers, disabled action reason, owner capability, evidence/activity location, cost impact, and next action without raw JSON, raw logs, raw policy dumps, raw private IDs, fake runnable repair actions, or DemoApp leakage.
playwrightTests: No new Playwright route is required unless UX labels change; future P66 UX must cover disabled repair actions, no raw dumps, dark/light/system themes, sidebar navigation, and route-wide safety tests.
testsCheckers: Add or keep P66-specific checker coverage for this subphase.
Keep backend/kernel behavior covered by checker scripts.
checkerUpdates: Keep check:os-phase-status and check:phase-validation-coverage aligned after P66 subphases are added.
docsRoadmap: Add or update P66 implementation plan doc.
Update NEXUS platform roadmap and OS phase status.
inputs.phaseStatusUpdate: Mark P66 in_progress, mark P66.1 complete after validation, and set nextPhase to P66.2.
